      "title": "compliance: T10 is assessed clause by clause against the SPEC_V2 section 12 gate. Clause 1 is proved for a project backlog by `crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs::wsjf_is_computed_not_stored` (line 179) and `::materialisation_respects_wip_slots` (line 215), with `crates/actions/tests/pi_plan_approval.rs::an_approved_plan_materialises_exactly_once` (line 297) and `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs::pi_tick_is_idempotent` (line 153); it is not proved for the programme's standing backlog (v1-p82-5). Clause 2 is proved by `crates/store/tests/demo_gate.rs::a_credit_needs_typed_evidence` (line 94) with `crates/actions/tests/demo_credit.rs` (lines 154 and 168). Clause 3 is proved by `crates/store/tests/retro.rs::retro_cannot_close_without_lessons` (line 190) and `::every_finding_becomes_a_lesson` (line 156), with the evidence gap v1-p82-6. Clause 4 has a named passing test, `crates/store/tests/tranche_review.rs::a_review_without_evidence_is_refused` (line 208), but it is unproved at HEAD: v1-p83-1 shows the three evidence keys accept free-text placeholders and the seed authorises tranches with no review, and v1-p83-4 shows the baseline is not gated. Clause 5 is proved by `crates/store/tests/benefit_transition.rs::a_missing_baseline_cannot_claim_realization` (line 194) and `::a_measured_baseline_enables_realization` (line 161), with the measurement-value gap v1-p83-2. The batch admitted eight findings \u2014 v1-p83-1 to v1-p83-5 (P1), v1-p83-6 (P2), v1-p82-5 (P2) and v1-p82-6 (P2). The compliance level is non_conformant; no finding is P0, so the manifest's product gate does not reopen the register's `closed` status. The rework's acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/T10.toml`.",
      "value": "T10 is assessed clause by clause against the SPEC_V2 section 12 gate. Clause 1 is proved for a project backlog by `crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs::wsjf_is_computed_not_stored` (line 179) and `::materialisation_respects_wip_slots` (line 215), with `crates/actions/tests/pi_plan_approval.rs::an_approved_plan_materialises_exactly_once` (line 297) and `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs::pi_tick_is_idempotent` (line 153); it is not proved for the programme's standing backlog (v1-p82-5). Clause 2 is proved by `crates/store/tests/demo_gate.rs::a_credit_needs_typed_evidence` (line 94) with `crates/actions/tests/demo_credit.rs` (lines 154 and 168). Clause 3 is proved by `crates/store/tests/retro.rs::retro_cannot_close_without_lessons` (line 190) and `::every_finding_becomes_a_lesson` (line 156), with the evidence gap v1-p82-6. Clause 4 has a named passing test, `crates/store/tests/tranche_review.rs::a_review_without_evidence_is_refused` (line 208), but it is unproved at HEAD: v1-p83-1 shows the three evidence keys accept free-text placeholders and the seed authorises tranches with no review, and v1-p83-4 shows the baseline is not gated. Clause 5 is proved by `crates/store/tests/benefit_transition.rs::a_missing_baseline_cannot_claim_realization` (line 194) and `::a_measured_baseline_enables_realization` (line 161), with the measurement-value gap v1-p83-2. The batch admitted eight findings \u2014 v1-p83-1 to v1-p83-5 (P1), v1-p83-6 (P2), v1-p82-5 (P2) and v1-p82-6 (P2). The compliance level is non_conformant; no finding is P0, so the manifest's product gate does not reopen the register's `closed` status. The rework's acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/T10.toml`."
    }
